result.rationale: The controller code in the diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` followed by `save_host(host)` in update and `host.destroy` in destroy, with no nil check, so a missing record yields NoMethodError and a 500. This is verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: update and destroy look up the host with where(id: params[:id]).first and immediately dereference it, so a request for a nonexistent id raises NoMethodError (save_host(nil) / nil.destroy) and returns a 500 instead of a 4xx. Any stale or hand-crafted PUT/DELETE to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id for an already-deleted record produces a 500 on the admin API.
